# GHS Symbols

> Chemical hazard reference and toxicology tools for EHS professionals: GHS classification, mixture ATE calculator, storage compatibility matrix, and per-substance hazard pages for 4,178 CLP Annex VI substances.

## Tools

- [Mixture ATE Calculator](https://ghssymbols.com/tools/ate-calculator/): Compute Acute Toxicity Estimate for mixtures using the GHS additive formula and bridging principles, with PDF export
- [Chemical Storage Compatibility Matrix](https://ghssymbols.com/tools/storage-matrix/): Determine which chemicals can be stored together based on GHS hazard classes and segregation rules

## Substance Database

- [Hazards Database](https://ghssymbols.com/hazards/): 4,178 substances from EU CLP Annex VI with harmonised classifications, GHS pictograms, signal words, H/P-statements, ATE values, and physical properties

## Reference

- [H-Statements](https://ghspictograms.com/h-statements/): Hazard statement codes (H200–H421, including EUH) with full CLP Annex III wording, hazard class and category, pictogram and signal word, UN GHS revision history, official combinations, and jurisdiction status (EU CLP / OSHA / UN GHS) — hosted on ghspictograms.com
- [P-Statements](https://ghspictograms.com/p-statements/): Precautionary statement codes (P101–P503) with full text, CLP Annex IV wording, official combinations, and jurisdiction status (EU CLP / OSHA / UN GHS) — hosted on ghspictograms.com
- [Blog](https://ghssymbols.com/blog/): In-depth articles on GHS signal words, chemical storage, H/P-statements, GHS vs OSHA HCS 2024, SVHC/REACH, bridging principles, and CMR substances
- [FAQ](https://ghssymbols.com/faq/): Common questions on GHS classification, hazard symbols, and chemical safety

## Sister sites

- [ghspictograms.com](https://ghspictograms.com): GHS pictogram library, CLP-compliant label constructor, UN number transport reference (ADR 2025 and 49 CFR 172.101 side by side), and Compliance Hub (UN GHS, OSHA HCS, CLP, SDS guides)
- [ghslabels.com](https://ghslabels.com): Certified GHS label ordering (BS5609 marine grade)

## Data

- 4,178 substances from EU CLP Annex VI (harmonised classification list)
- ATE values, H-statements, P-statements, GHS pictograms for each substance
- Mixture ATE Calculator implements the GHS Annex 3 additive formula
- Storage Matrix derived from GHS hazard class segregation rules
